title: Hybrid cosmopsychism: subjects emerge, their experience is inherited

statements.text: Basic laws make new local subjects emerge from the conscious universe, which is strong emergence about subjects. But the subjects bring no new phenomenal properties: they inherit instances the universe already bore, and give them back at death, which is weak emergence about experience.

sources.quote: strong emergentism about subjects combined with weak emergentism about the conscious states of emergent subjects
these strongly emergent subjects do not appear with their own phenomenal property instances; rather they 'inherit' phenomenal property instances which previously belonged to the universe
